text:
sam: Heads-up — p95 on /v1/generate jumped 220ms around the canary rollout at 08:45 but sample_count on the p95 tile dropped. looks like routing fallback to "cheaper-variant" influenced the rollup. any ideas?
maria: saw that too. Dashboard shows p50 stable, p95 up, p99 unchanged. seems like p95 is coming from a different sample origin after fallback? :thinking:
jin: can you paste the query you used for the percentiles? we need to know whether the console is merging route-tagged tdigests or using raw endpoint samples.
sam: sure — this is the backend query used for the rollup (simplified):
```
SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, count() AS sample_count
FROM request_latency
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate'
  AND region = 'us-west'
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SAMPLE BY route_variant
```
sam: after canary, `route_variant` weight changed and fallback reads from `route_variant=cheaper-variant` for some bins. p95 now reflects merged tdigest from mixed origins.
olivia: that explains the dropped sample_count on the p95 tile — UI is showing merged quantile but sample_count is only from a single origin tag? UX bug.
maria: we should show provenance: p50/p95/p99 badges with a small "origin" label (e.g., raw, merged, fallback) and sample_count per origin. that would prevent misinterpreting SLO alerts.
jin: agree. Also need to decide on telemetry: should we expose `percentile_origin` tag in the rollup API? currently internal API returns {p50, p95, p99, sample_count} only. proposal: add `sample_breakdown` map and `rollup_strategy` string.
deploy-bot: deployment canary completed at 08:46, 8/10 nodes reported `route_fallback=true`.
sam: thoughts on shape of `sample_breakdown`? we could do a small flat list: `origin=raw,count=123` lines. UI friendly.
maria: minimal surface for now: include `sample_breakdown` as CSV-like string in API: `raw:123,merged:89,fallback:45`. no nested JSON to keep old clients working.
jin: internal API change will require a feature flag `show_origin_hint`. backend will populate `sample_breakdown` when enabled. we'll also need a migration plan for dashboards that compute p95 from raw samples — add a console warning when origins mix.
olivia: UX note — tooltip copy: "P95 is computed from merged rollups. Click to see origin counts and fallback timeline." Also add small yellow pill when origin mixing > 10%.
sam: quick ask: can eng-platform add a temporary endpoint-breakdown panel per endpoint that lists p50/p95/p99 per `route_variant`? that will help root cause on future rollouts.
maria: +1, we already have per-route metrics, just need a compact panel and a query param `?split_by=route_variant`. will mock up in the console next sprint. :thumbsup:
jin: I'll own the backend change (api + flag) and a small migration note in the docs. estimate 2d work.
sam: thanks. putting a follow-up: add an alert rule to fire only when p95 increases AND merged_origin_share < 25% so we avoid noisy alerts for rollouts that intentionally route traffic.
olivia: sounds good. I'll file a tiny UX ticket and attach mockups. link: https://redwood-internal.design/tickets/3712
sam: cool. re-check in the morning after the next canary. if anyone sees similar anomalies, ping me.
